title: Luanna B NDE 13069
content: I am a lawyer in Brazil who fights for the legal rights of people with ADHD. A doctor (angiologist) asked me to be a co-author of a 'scientific' article that had nothing to do with science. It was a document mixing Freud, dark magic, homeopathy, eugenics and phrenology to explain a cure for ADHD through genetic modifications during pregnancy. Even I question my own sanity talking about this. I didn't want anything to do with his article. Then I received information that he was removing drug addicts from rehabilitation clinics by saying they had ADHD and that he would cure their drug addiction with holistic Apometry therapies. I have been working as a volunteer in an organization that supports the families of drug addicts in rehabilitation since I was 16 years old. My father died of liver cirrhosis due to alcoholism. Since I am a reference in the subject of ADHD, several rehabilitation clinics, human rights NGOs, etc., people came to me asking if I knew that doctor and commented on his psychotic episodes. A Mother Superior of a nursing home, transferred from the Vatican, came to me and told me that he was using the name of the nursing home to publish these articles. When I went to question him, he told me that he was the Messiah sent to end the curse of autism and ADHD. At that moment, I began to actively and publicly combat these absurdities. I sent a message to his ex-wife's lawyer showing my concern for his two children under 3 years old. His ex-wife fled with the children to another state. Months before my message, she had already filed a request for a police investigation for violence and other things that I do not know about. While all this was happening, I was participating in a podcast talking about the need for ADHD diagnosis to be done by professionals, specialized in psychiatry, and to verify the doctor's credentials. When I finished the podcast, I went to a bar to meet a group of colleagues who were already drunk. I ordered a drink and drank half of it before going to the bathroom. I remember taking two more sips. I then had flashes of memory of being dragged through a pasture with tall grass, feeling my legs scratching on barbed wire. I was feeling extremely cold water, hearing the sound of a waterfall. Suddenly, everything went dark. I have NEVER been in a waterfall before. I went back to the scene where I was in the back seat of the car, smelling of engine oil typical of cars from the 1990s/1995s. My father was driving. My mother was in the seat next to me. I realized that I was reliving the moment when I read my first word at 2-1/2 years old. I was reliving the sensations and seeing the look of surprise between my parents was something that my soul really needed to see. In less than a second, I was about 40 years old playing with a girl I called Zoé. She was my daughter. I felt a love for that child that I had never felt for anyone else in the world. Suddenly everything went dark again. I saw a very strong light and heard a voice saying, 'Daughter, come back! Your mission has not yet begun. There are many lives that still need you. You know that you are special. You know that you are my sheep from other folds. Remember that this is part of a work for the good of your brothers on the terrestrial orb and that if you give up now, you will not have another opportunity for such a big leap in your own evolution. Daughter, come back! We are proud that you have not forgotten moral integrity and especially that you do not fear the evil of the earthly. But, there is much more to be experienced and faced. There is suffering in being female, in having ADHD, in being autistic; suffering in being gifted and suffering in Being. Everything on Earth is suffering, but you chose to be help out of love for your companions. We are One. Come back and do not forget that I am part of every atom that makes up your flesh and that We are One Spirit, on the path to coming together again and BEING!' I woke up with the sun burning my face in a pasture. The base of my spine was fractured. I looked to the side and there was an inverted pentagram drawn with red earth on the grass, a cross made with branches stuck in the ground upside down and a piece of black silk with an embroidered writing in Latin, 'Et in nomine ejus, et sicut illi, immolabuntur servi Nazareni electi. Vivet Lucis' In English, this means: 'And in his name, and like him, the chosen servants of the Nazarene will be sacrificed. Long live Lucis' I have no idea what sect or psychic outbreak this is part of, but if he wasn't so dangerous, I would even give him a hug to thank him for changing my existence in such an incredible way. arrival.religious_figure_detail: Identified the voice/presence as “Master Jesus Christ”.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: A voice/light told her: “Daughter, come back! Your mission has not yet begun. There are many lives that still need you… this is part of a work for the good of your brothers on the terrestrial orb… you chose to be help out of love for your companions.”

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Criminal attack involving drug/medication overdose; she reports the intent was that she would not remain alive, but dosage was insufficient for greater organ damage.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Kardecist spiritualist (prior); afterward: continues attending Kardecism, considers herself Christian and studies multiple religions.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Nonlinear “multiple existences and dimensions”; included a future scene of being ~40 years old playing with a daughter named Zoé; then darkness; then light/voice; then awakening in a pasture with ritual-like objects nearby.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Reported tunnel plus repeated darkness/scene shifts (past memory re-experienced, then future scene, then light/voice and barrier, then return).
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Darkness/blackouts and scene transitions occurred more than once (“Suddenly everything went dark again”).

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Flashes of being dragged through tall grass and barbed wire; cold water and waterfall sound (she states she had never been to a waterfall). On waking, she found an inverted pentagram drawn with red earth, an upside-down cross made of branches, and black silk with Latin text: “Et in nomine ejus, et sicut illi, immolabuntur servi Nazareni electi. Vivet Lucis” (translated by her as: “And in his name, and like him, the chosen servants of the Nazarene will be sacrificed. Long live Lucis”).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Daughter, come back! Your mission has not yet begun. There are many lives that still need you… We are One… Everything on Earth is suffering, but you chose to be help out of love for your companions.”
